segments.text: These are sample answers. Use your own information when you practice.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: When was your last English test?
segments.instructions: Ask a neutral information question with a gentle falling finish.

segments.text: My last English test was last week.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Did you pass it or fail it?
segments.instructions: Ask a choice question, rising on the first choice and falling on the final choice.

segments.text: I passed it.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Was it easy, or was it too difficult for you?
segments.instructions: Ask a choice question, rising on the first choice and falling on the final choice.

segments.text: It was easy enough for me to pass.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Are you old enough to be a member of the local sports club?
segments.instructions: Ask a genuine question with a gentle natural rise.

segments.text: Yes, I am old enough to be a member.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Are you old enough to drive a car?
segments.instructions: Ask a genuine question with a gentle natural rise.

segments.text: No, I'm not old enough to drive a car.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Are you old enough to ride a motor-bike?
segments.instructions: Ask a genuine question with a gentle natural rise.
